sc: It can be made at a forge and anvil using 10 adamant bars and an adamant chainbody + 1, requiring 2,500 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,700 Smithing experience.
Ancient vis is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 25 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
Archon tassets are an Armadylean item obtained from Treasure Hunter.
It was a possible super rare reward from the rare drop table.
It was originally obtained as a reward from the Parcels from the Hedge and Frank's Free Chest events.
The material received from the auto-screener will be placed into the player's inventory and can be duplicated by a waterfiend familiar.
This also applies to material caches; any soil obtained from caches will be screened for only the material available at the cache.
Avaryss' braid is a pet unlock item which may be obtained by defeating the Twin Furies at the Heart of Gielinor.
A bagged dead tree can be bought in Falador from the Garden supplier for 1,000 coins.
It can be crafted into Dead tree (furniture) on the Furniture workbench to be placed in a Player-owned house.
Bamboo is a resource obtained from chopping bamboo stalks found on the isles of Waiko, Tuai Leit, North-eastern Aminishi, and Uncharted Isles.
Bamboo may be obtained occasionally from pickpocketing Waiko islanders near the Waiko marketplace.

Beast (Veteran) Gauntlets.x: Beast (Veteran) Gauntlets is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Beast (Veteran) outfit.

Path of the Creators - Part II

sc: Unlike other nails, they cannot be made with the Smithing skill.
They are possible loot from zogre tombs and a drop from zombie hands.
They are a possible reward from opening an easy reward casket as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Heraldic armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be decorated by any players.
They can be created at level 50 Crafting with one blue dragon leather, granting 70 Crafting experience.
A Broav is an object pet obtained during the quest While Guthix Sleeps.
To obtain it, a wild broav must be caught in a pitfall trap west of Hunting expert using a mort myre fungus.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 necronium bars and a necronium battleaxe, requiring 1,280 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,000 Smithing experience.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.
The outfit piece can be created by combining 3,600 shark fragments at an inventor's workbench, where the player will randomly receive 1 piece of all the shark outfits until all are owned.
They were previously possible to obtain from Treasure Hunter from 26 March 2015 00:00 UTC to 30 March 2015 23:59 UTC.
Christmas jumper (Chinchompa) is a body unlocked by redeeming a Christmas jumper token (chinchompa).
The cloud key was received from the cloud spirit during the 2011 Easter event.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
It was found in a pile in the Easter Bunny's rabbit hole.

Construct of Strength Legplates.x: Construct of Strength Legplates is a recolourable legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Construct of Strength outfit.

h: Crown of Seasons (Squeal of Fortune promotion)
tx: The Coronet of Summer can no longer be crafted since 22 July 2013.
sc: The Coronet of Summer was made by combining 500 lush blossoms.
It is made by firing a cracked hunter urn (unf) in a pottery oven or at a portable crafter, requiring level 3 Crafting and giving 18 Crafting experience.

Crux Eqal sword.x: Crux Eqal sword is a cosmetic override. It was unlocked by pre-registering for RuneScape Mobile prior to its release. The override can also be unlocked by logging into the Mobile version of the game after 17 June 2021.

From Medium Forgotten Belongings.
First time becoming available to Ironman Mode players.
sc: Crypt shieldbow token is a token which could originally be won from Treasure Hunter during the Boneyard promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Crypt Shieldbow override, destroying the token.

A D&D token (the circus) is an item that was a possible prize from the Squeal of Fortune, granting the player an extra round of training at Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza and its corresponding reward.
Though the Distractions and Diversions specific tokens are no longer obtainable in game, an item with a similar function known as a D&D token was later released.
The decorated runecrafting urn (full) is an urn made by fully filling a decorated runecrafting urn while runecrafting.
Devotion dust is obtainable from the devotion rocks scattered around the Lumbridge Crater during the 2017 Valentine's Day event.
Devotion dust can obtained by Mining and Smithing the crashed devotion rocks, or taken in groups of 500 from the crate of devotion dust near Wizard Deedit.

Elf-style boots (silver).x: The silver elf-style boots are part of the elven outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: The Epic of Hebe, excerpt 5 is an item that can be obtained by excavating at the acropolis debris or bibliotheke debris excavation hotspots at the Everlight Dig Site.
The exquisite hunter urn (full) is an item made by filling an exquisite hunter urn while hunting creatures.
Fine flour is an item received from Gil in the process of completing the achievement Laid to Rest.
Fremennik cloaks are capes made by Yrsa.
They can be bought from Yrsa's clothes shop in western Rellekka after completing The Fremennik Trials.

Golden chinchompa ball.x: The golden chinchompa ball is an item transformed from the large gnomeball from Treasure Hunter. It is obtained by kicking a large gnomeball 500 times.

sc: The ice warrior chestplate is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
Incandescent Outfit is a recolourable cosmetic override outfit that can be claimed while having Premier Membership active from the game update on 4 November 2024.
Players cannot exchange these tokens at the Max Guild, but Elen Anterth will sell inverted master skillcapes unlocked by the player.
The Jas Neophyte's 2h Crossbow is cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 45 of Path of the Creators event.
Jormungand Cape is obtained by handing in 8,000 valkyrie feathers to Eir during the 2019 winter event.
Kelda seeds are obtained during the Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf quest.
There are four of them and must be obtained from the various friends of the drunken dwarf with one of them received from the dwarf himself.
Players may obtain one after completing the first archaeology exam.

Loathsome rogue gloves are a pair of gloves that can be bought for 300 Deathmatch points from the Deathmatch Reward Shop after the previous pairs have been bought, setting the total points required at 1,200 points.
Prior to the release of Deathmatch, rogue gloves could be found in the Crucible.

r: Lower decorated masterwork bow grip support
Lower decorated masterwork bow grip support
sc: It is made by socketing a faceted ascended sapphire into a masterwork bow grip support, requiring 250 progress.
The lucky chaotic claw is a piece of lucky equipment that can be won from Treasure Hunter from 13 March 2015 0:00 UTC onwards.

tx: Activities from which lush blossoms could be acquired

• Cutting and splitting arctic pines.
• Cutting all free-to-play and members-only trees. (including ivy and Crystal trees)
• Cutting Jade roots in the Jadinko Lair.
• Cutting timber at the Citadel woodcutting skilling plot.
• Lumber Yard.
sc: Lush blossoms are the components of the Cloak of Summer, and are won through playing Treasure Hunter, or awarded while Woodcutting.
The number of blossoms obtained appears to be based roughly on the amount of experience gained, rather than the number of actions the player does.
They are obtained after cutting down a maple tree (using the investigate option of the tree) and can be crafted into a spile by investigating the logs.
A megaleather coif is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
The mummy hand is dropped by the skeleton looter.
If lost or destroyed, the mummy hand can be found in the hallway where you killed the golem.
Notes (a-j) are found in a bookcase underneath Zemouregal's fort.
If lost after completing the quest, it can be found in its original place again.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins, as well as in the Christmas Spirit Shop for 5,000 Christmas spirit.

Off-hand twang crossbow.x: The off-hand twang crossbow is an item that was originally made available from the rare token store on 31 March 2016. Currently it can be obtained when the main hand variant is bought from Marketplace for 250 oddments, or generated through the main hand variant for 100,000 coins.

sc: It may be produced using the Smithing skill or obtained as a monster drop.
To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 300 chompies, then talk to Rantz.

Ornate Maul.x: Ornate Maul is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Ornate Heavy Melee Weapon Pack.

sc: The former could be obtained from pineapple plants but when fresh pineapples were released as part of gnome cooking, pineapple plants yielded the fresh ones instead.

The original pineapples which were then sometimes referred to as 'old pineapple' by players was no longer obtainable for a short time, but was later added to the droptable of jogres which still drop them to this day.
Pink Offhand Candy Cane is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Pink Candy Cane Token.
Plain whirligig shells are obtained when hunting plain whirligigs inside Het's Oasis.
It is made by using a platinum bar, a dragonstone and a ring mould at a furnace, requiring level 104 Crafting.
A premade fruit batta is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree.
The prized pendant of Firemaking is a pendant of skill that may be obtained as a prize from the Squeal of Fortune.

Ranger boots (white).x: White ranger boots are obtained by recolouring Ranger boots by using them on Diango. The Ranger Boots (re-colour) service could be purchased from Solomon's General Store for 4,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle from the Marketplace. When attempting to do so, the player will receive the message "This item can only be upgraded in its un

sc: Raw undead chicken is an item obtained by killing undead chickens on the farm to the west of the Ectofuntus.

Rock-shell armour set.x: Rock-shell armour set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items from rock-shell armour with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: Royal chitin is an item obtained by defeating the Kalphite Queen or the Exiled Kalphite Queen with necromancy after accepting but before completing Kili's Knowledge V (power) task, provided that the player has less than 5 royal chitin.
It is a possible reward from completing hard clue scrolls as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion, or from cremating at the Columbarium.
Trimmed rune armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be trimmed by any players.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.
Seasinger Acolyte is a cosmetic override set that can be bought from Boni in Waiko, for 5,000 chimes and 2 taijitu.
It is made by using the silver needle on the flour barrel.
The small combat training dummy crate is an item that could formerly be obtained from Treasure Hunter or Double XP Live daily rewards.
Smite (Tier 3) is obtained from the Zamorakian quartermaster or the Saradominist quartermaster for 150 Renown.
A soul rune obtained in the Runespan is created by siphoning soul esswraiths, living souls (both requiring 90 Runecrafting) or undead souls (with 95 Runecrafting).
A soul urn is an item given to the player by Kili after reaching level 50 Necromancy.
It needs be filled with either 75 souls obtained by killing demons, or 10 souls from performing lesser communion rituals.
A spare arrow shaft is a quest item that can be found after searching the arrow shafts in the quest-specific instance of Shifting Tombs during Pharaoh's Folly.

Steel crossbow (unstrung) is an unfinished crossbow which can be created at level 23 Fletching by joining a willow stock with steel limbs, granting 28 Fletching experience.
The summer storm ring is an item that was available from the Squeal of fortune throughout the summer months.

Supreme growth potion (woody) is a type of growth potion which can be bought alongside other growth potions from the Farmers' Market or its Anachronia Dinosaur Farm branch for 4,000 beans, or from Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 30,000 Crux Eqal favour.

sc: A willow logs certificate was an item from RuneScape Classic that was created by using five willow logs on Chuck.

Wrathful Gauntlets.x: The Wrathful Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Wrathful Armour set.

v: Only during Land of the Goblins and if the player doesn't already have the item.
sc: To obtain the key the player must first go to the Goblin Cave and turn into a goblin using a goblin potion.

The player must then wear yellow goblin mail in order to be able to access the Yurkolgokh goblin tribe's area in the cave, and can then pickpocket the Yurkolgokh priest to obtain the Yurkolgokh key required to continue the quest.
The zombie mask was previously a reward from the Leo the Gravedigger random event.
It can now be purchased for 500 coins from Iffie's Random Costume Shop, located in Thessalia's Fine Clothes store in Varrock.
